post_release_projection.model: OLS velocity from last 3 consecutive post-release ground-plane samples; anchor at last measured point. Receiver continues straight. Ball swept cone spans all assumed paths up to the displayed time, ±15 deg heading and up to +20 percent speed; slower -20 percent scenarios lie inside. Not a calibrated landing or catch model.
post_release_projection.timeline: One continuous timeline through measured frames, followed by projection to 2.0 s after release. No separate projection slider. requestAnimationFrame interpolates recorded samples and moves projections continuously. Fixed camera bounds include the full cone from the beginning.
post_release_projection.interpolation: Visual interpolation adds no evidence samples. Pausing/scrubbing snaps to a 0.1 s step. Other players freeze and dim during projection.
post_release_projection.boundary: 3.3 throw, recorded 3.4/3.5/3.6/3.7, projected 3.8 through 5.3 s on the Schwartz play. Slider reaches its right end at 5.3 s.
post_release_projection.fallback: Albert Wilson play 3415 ends at the last measured sample; insufficient 2-sample data yields no cone.
post_release_projection.html: Unique IDs, valid anchors/companion links, one range input, no external assets, removed review notes remain absent.
